title: Number of 1 Bits
description: Given a positive integer, return the number of set bits (1s) in its binary representation (its Hamming weight).

reference.use_case: Counting how many flags are set in a bitmask, such as how many permissions a user holds or how many rows a filter matched in a bitmap.
system_examples: Bitmap indexes (Roaring bitmaps in Apache Druid and Lucene) — counting matching rows
Chess engines — counting pieces and attacked squares on bitboards with the CPU POPCNT instruction
Similarity search — Hamming distance between binary embeddings or perceptual image hashes
reference.explanation: n & (n − 1) clears the lowest set bit, so looping until zero takes one iteration per set bit, and CPUs provide a single POPCNT instruction. Popcount is a hot primitive in bitmap indexes, bitboard engines, and Hamming-distance search.
